stories.title: Coroner identifies man found dead in car in Lower Richland County
stories.summary: The vehicle was found in a ditch and investigators say the death is suspicious.

stories.title: SC State University student killed in car crash in Aiken County
stories.summary: SC State said Carter was a marketing major at the school.

stories.title: First No Fleas Market raises money for Columbia Animal Services, helps dogs find new homes
stories.summary: Organizer Isabelle Riley’s late rescue dog was once on a euthanasia list. Several dogs found new homes at Saturday’s event.

stories.title: Lexington woman, 79, dies of injuries from Willma Ann Drive house fire, coroner says
stories.summary: Dale Princess Windham died at the scene Saturday night. The Lexington County Fire Service and SLED are investigating.

stories.title: Coroner identifies Columbia man who died in Jamil Temple gun show shooting
stories.summary: Telvin Pierre Portee, 34, died at the scene Saturday. A Lexington County deputy working security was shot and returned fire.

stories.title: Former Gamecock MiLaysia Fulwiley arrested after Baton Rouge traffic stop, faces 5 charges
stories.summary: The Columbia native, now at LSU, is held on a $20,000 bond. A since-deleted post on what appears to be her account denies hitting an officer.

stories.title: Lexington County family remembers 79-year-old woman who died in Willma Ann Drive house fire
stories.summary: Dale Windham’s son tried to reach her inside the burning home. Her granddaughter says she enjoyed church, cooking and her grandkids.

stories.title: Coroner identifies 2 men who died in Clarendon County shooting on Mallett Road
stories.summary: Jonathan Lucas, 26, of Manning, and Harold Bradley Jr., 38, of Alcolu, died after deputies say the two shot each other.

stories.title: SC teen dies after touching downed power lines following Aiken County crash, coroner says
stories.summary: Quentavious Carter, 18, got out after his car hit a utility pole on Atomic Road early Sunday. Live wires had fallen on the car.

stories.title: Man gets 45 years for murdering West Columbia woman on I-26 ramp in Newberry County
stories.summary: Prosecutors say a woman was fatally shot while trying to escape along I-26 near Prosperity. Her killer was sentenced to 45 years in prison.

stories.title: Driver dies after climbing out of wrecked car on I-26 and being hit, troopers say
stories.summary: The driver had gotten out after the car overturned early Saturday near mile marker 101. Another driver was taken to a hospital.

stories.title: Lexington County deputy shot at Jamil Temple gun show returns fire, kills shooter, authorities say
stories.summary: The deputy was in surgery and stable Saturday afternoon. The association holding the show canceled Sunday’s session.
